picks.title: Saturated Sunday: Two Options - Religion to Redemption - Matthew S6E7
picks.summary:
In Matthew 26, we see two very different responses to Jesus. 
Mary pours out what is most valuable to her in extravagant worship, while Judas chooses his own way when Jesus does not give him what he wants.
Religion asks what we can get from Jesus. Redemption recognizes what Jesus has already done for us and responds by surrendering everything to Him. There is no middle ground. 
We can live life our own way, or we can fall at the feet of Jesus and pour out our lives for the One who poured out His life for us.
